\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\title{Exact Lyapunov Weights for Multichannel Defect Kernels}
\author{}
\date{}
\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
We solve an exact retained-state weighting problem with a regular state and
multiple center, continuous, orbit, and topology defect channels.  The
solution quantifies the trade between rare entry, forced return, and defect
persistence.  It shows precisely what physical conditional estimates a
state-weighted Yang--Mills argument must supply.
\end{abstract}

\section{Star defect kernel}
Let state $0$ be regular and $i=1,\dots,n$ label defect channels.  Consider
the positive subkernel
\[
 Q(0,i)=a_i,\qquad Q(i,0)=b_i,\qquad Q(i,i)=c_i,
\]
with all other entries zero and subprobability rows.

\begin{theorem}
Fix $q>\max_i c_i$ and suppose
$b_i/(q-c_i)\ge1$.  Set
\[
 V(0)=1,\qquad V(i)=\frac{b_i}{q-c_i}.
\]
Then
\[
 QV\le qV
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \sum_{i=1}^n\frac{a_i b_i}{q-c_i}\le q.
\]
Every defect row is exactly saturated when $b_i>0$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
For a defect state,
\[
 \frac{(QV)(i)}{V(i)}=\frac{b_i}{V(i)}+c_i=q.
\]
At the regular state,
$(QV)(0)/V(0)=\sum_i a_iV(i)$, yielding the stated equivalence.
\end{proof}

Thus persistence cannot be hidden in the weight: necessarily $c_i<q$.
When $b_i=1$ and $c_i=0$, the minimum feasible ceiling is
\[
 q_{\min}=\sqrt{\sum_i a_i}.
\]

\section{Four-channel calibration}
For
\[
 q=0.002430277501841998
\]
and four forced-return, zero-persistence channels, equal entry allocation
requires
\[
 \sum_i a_i=q^2=5.90624873596\cdot10^{-6},
 \qquad a_i=1.47656218399\cdot10^{-6}.
\]
The charged weight is $V_i=411.47564393$.  The free-energy costs are
\[
 -\log q^2=12.03949966,
 \qquad -\log a_i=13.42579402.
\]
The scalar row ceiling is nevertheless one because a defect can force the
following bad transition.

\section{Frontier}
The theorem explains the mechanism but does not provide the physical rates
$a_i,b_i,c_i$.  The retained local representation supplies center and orbit
labels, while a genuine topological sector is absent on the current simply
connected local block.  Uniform conditional entry, persistence, and topology
estimates remain open.
